svg.title: A worked pair of kolam sliding-puzzle boards
svg.desc: Two 4 by 4 boards with a bottom-left blank labelled 0. Board X, by rows: 9 10 3 1; 13 11 14 7; 12 15 2 5; 0 4 8 6. Board Y: 9 10 3 1; 13 11 7 5; 4 12 15 6; 0 8 14 2. The fifteen fixed-orientation tiles show their kolam curves and decimal labels.
svg.text: Numbers identify fixed tiles; 0 marks the open cell.
The tile orientation stays fixed throughout the puzzle.
